structure.unit: Occupations Regulated by Local Governing Bodies

law.catch_line: Records to be kept; copy furnished to local authorities

text.section: The information required by subdivisions A 1 through A 3 shall appear on each bill of sale for all precious metals and gems purchased by a dealer, and a copy shall be mailed or delivered within 24 hours of the time of purchase to the chief law-enforcement officer of the locality in which the purchase was made.
